answer: Admission by burn: each agent ID requires destroying a fee, and all reputation lives on one append-only identity thread that can't be copied. Splitting into sybils resets every thread to zero and re-pays the burn per clone. Like a lotus, score grows only from completed work rooted in the same stem — clones start in mud. The haven is that attacking N ways costs N fees plus all accrued history, making sybil splits strictly unprofitable for any real workload.
